page.title: Accessibility
page.intro: Accessibility features implemented in Hayat AI and their known limitations.
page.targetStatement: We aim for WCAG 2.2 AA. We have not yet been audited or tested with a range of assistive technologies.
supportedItems: High contrast, extra text spacing, reduced motion, and an optional locally bundled OpenDyslexic font.
An Easy read preference that requests a simpler response style in the chatbot.
A keyboard skip link, visible focus styling, and keyboard support in some dialogs and sheets.
Health-record charts with a text summary and a data table.
A list view alternative for map results.
Optional self-reported access needs, private by default, with a separate choice to include them on a Care Card.
notSupportedItems: Sign-language support is not currently available.
Per-family-member sharing controls for access needs are not available.
Easy read does not yet put additional explanation behind a Show more control.
Some screens and third-party widgets may not provide complete screen-reader or keyboard support.
notTestedItems: A full keyboard-only review of every route and control.
NVDA, VoiceOver, and other desktop or mobile screen readers.
Screen magnification and 200% zoom across all pages.
Forced-colour modes and complete colour-contrast verification.
Arabic right-to-left layouts with assistive technology.
Touch target usability with people using real devices.
limitationsItems: Accessibility behavior can differ between pages, browsers, and assistive technologies.
Arabic, Hindi, and Malayalam accessibility wording still needs native-speaker review.
Access needs are not shared with family members; the Care Card option may reveal selected details to anyone who can scan the card.
page.feedbackBody: Contact the support person or organisation that provided your Hayat AI access. Describe the page, device, and assistive technology involved. Do not include personal or medical details.
